threshold_policy.rule: These limits are frozen before any 1D.2 GMAT ephemeris is generated and must never be loosened to obtain a pass.

scientific_scope: This matrix is authorized only by the independently passed and checksum-gated 1D.1 short-arc result.
All GMAT and Python models use the same frozen normalized JGM2 coefficients and validated full GMAT R2026a EOP realization.
GMAT STK-TimePosVel states are accepted only on the preregistered 60-second grid tolerance; state vectors are never interpolated by Research Core.
Tides, drag, third bodies, solar radiation pressure, and relativity are disabled.
The thresholds must not be changed after inspecting any 1D.2 GMAT output.
A pass closes controlled higher-order gravity software-model validation; it is not measured-orbit truth or flight qualification.
